name: difflearn
description: Local Git evidence and untrusted agent context CLI for developers working with coding agents.
author: Jolyne Starchaser

scripts.setup: npm ci --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund && npm run build && npm link --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund
scripts.test: npm run build && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test --test-concurrency=4 .test-dist/tests/cli.test.js .test-dist/tests/config.test.js .test-dist/tests/discovery.test.js .test-dist/tests/status.test.js .test-dist/tests/diff.test.js .test-dist/tests/evidence.test.js .test-dist/tests/language.test.js .test-dist/tests/candidates.test.js .test-dist/tests/review.test.js
